style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, misty mint #D9E9E5 for hero and closing, deep teal-grey #3B535C for info bands, warm cream #EFE9E1 for lifestyle and macro

style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh daily-necessities visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, misty mint #D9E9E5, deep teal-grey #3B535C and one caramel accent #C9A287; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with a small leaf motif; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered pack placement and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: pack sits stable and centered; consistent pack scale across the set; sheets rendered soft and airy
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC and soft fabric-textured board #EFE9E1
